author: 1Theodore1
body:
I started this temple about a couple of months ago, on april's server. Didn't really have any maps in my mind, but of course I wanted to turn it into a map.  A couple of days ago I decided to make a map with it, April's server started crashing, so I finished on my server, and it turned out pretty well! I showed it to ParaSpider on skype, he liked it so I finished it.

*Fixed Download, added minor details.
